purpose: State-scoped coverage inventory for Georgia 2024 result, review, turnout, map, historical, and election-administration context sources. This inventory records source availability and blockers; it does not promote production data and does not allege fraud or misconduct.
authorityPriority: Official Georgia Secretary of State, county election offices, official GIS/Census, EAC, and official audit/recount records first; secondary sources are context only and caveated.

caveats: County presidential candidate rows sum 19 votes higher than the statewide presidential contest total in minor-party/other rows.
U.S. House is district-based and candidate-specific, so Georgia directional screens are low-confidence advisory context rather than candidate-benefit findings.
One-sided House comparison rows and multi-district composite precinct keys are not down-ballot dropoff evidence.
EAC fallback turnout is official national reporting context, not Georgia-native same-grain turnout denominator data.
Turnout rows are county/jurisdiction grain while review rows are precinct grain.

loadedArtifacts.sourceAuthority: Georgia Secretary of State; U.S. Election Assistance Commission
caveats: The SOS media export groupResults are candidate votes by method for a contest, not all-ballot turnout by method.
The loaded SOS media export and 2012/2016/2020 historical media exports do not expose registered-voter denominator fields.
President candidate votes are 47,453 below EAC ballots cast, so this source is not a turnout replacement.
County geometry supports current county result map joins.
Precinct boundary geometry is not included.
Historical rows are contextual baselines only, not 2024 certified data.
The 2020 media export reports the original November general-election export total; separate recount result tables should be reconciled before replacing or combining those rows.

caveats: Do not infer every precinct or ballot mode used one identical setup; do not use this as vote, turnout, audit, or incident evidence.

officialSourceSearchPath.result: The official SOS media-export family is loaded for 2024 result/review rows and for 2012/2016/2020 county historical baselines. The 2024 export also includes candidate groupResults by vote method for President.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: The export does not provide precinct boundary geometry, registered-voter denominator fields, or election-level ballots-cast fields needed for state-native turnout replacement.

confidenceNotes: Official 2024 result/review rows and official 2012/2016/2020 county historical baselines are loaded from Georgia SOS media exports.
Current Georgia advisory indicators remain public-interest screening outputs only; they are not proof of fraud or misconduct.

Next source step is Georgia-native turnout/registration denominator collection and precinct boundary/crosswalk collection, followed by county/state requests for detailed audit, CVR, recount, incident, correction, and custody records.
A July 5, 2026 source review confirmed Georgia SOS vote-method groupResults are candidate-result splits, not turnout/registration denominator rows; EAC turnout remains active.
